name: pmcro-csuite
description: Consolidated C-suite plugin: 12 Chief persona agents plus 2 parameterized command skills. Merges the former 12 pmcro-chief-* plugins into one package; govern-<domain>-intent and select-reasoning-strategy are now single skills taking chief_id as an arg instead of 12 near-duplicate copies.

skills.name: govern-domain-intent
skills.description: Turn a seed into a governed <Domain>IntentFrame for a named Chief (arg: chief_id, seed).

skills.name: select-reasoning-strategy
skills.description: Select a reasoning strategy id for a named Chief's seed, delegating to pmcro-omode (arg: chief_id, seed).

notes: Formerly 12 separate plugins (pmcro-chief-*), now consolidated. Each Chief's omode.yaml preserved under omode/<id>.yaml.
Chiefs may [govern-domain-intent, select-reasoning-strategy]; mayNot [execute-provider-action, seal-cycle, issue-disposition, rewrite-laws].
Governed by L-EVIDENCE, L-CHECKER-GATE, L-PLUGIN-ISOLATION, L-OUTPUT-CONTRACT.
